page.notes:
The page number reads "294" (the printed "2" has a decorative form). The running head is "Ex. 2. C. 3. An Dei beneplacit." with the abbreviation as printed. Long s was rendered as a plain s throughout. The printed "ff" ligature in "fuiffet" is transcribed as "ss" ("fuisset"). Spelling of u/v and i/j was normalised, so "vifum" is "visum", "fubjicimur" is "subjicimur" and "juftitiæ" is "justitiæ". The paragraph opening "3." is a

, not a . The catchword "quæ" is at the right below the last line. No printing faults were confirmed.
